games.name: Foresters 🌳 [RELEASE]
games.desc:
Foresters 🌳 

Grab your axe and become a legendary lumberjack! Chop, saw and sell your way across an open world in this chill, grindy lumber adventure.

How to Chop
• Hold down on a tree to wind up your swing
• Let go when the ring is full for a powerful first hit!
• Dots appear on the trunk. Click each one as the closing ring meets it; it's okay to miss a few!
• Fill the notch to yell "Timber!" and bring the tree down
• Carry your wood to a sawmill for a perfect cut, then sell it to a merchant for Bucks!

Please like and favorite the game. The game is in very early beta so expect bugs.

Inspired by Fisch and Lumber Tycoon.
